class_id: shared config not shipped by the code deploy
feature: scripts/deploy-linux.sh (shared/config symlink) + scripts/ops/deploy-config.sh + any schema-validated config file
symptom: a config file inside a release is a SYMLINK to a shared, slot-scoped file that the code deploy deliberately never overwrites (the same pattern as shared/env and shared/certs). A commit that tightens the config SCHEMA and updates the repo's copy of the config in the SAME change therefore ships the new validator against the OLD config, because only a separate manual command replaces the shared file. The loader refuses at process start and the service is dead — silently, because the deploy's own gate checks served sha, migrations and row counts, none of which require the service to start. Universal shape: any config whose validator ships on the code path while its VALUE ships on a different path can be broken by a single commit that touches both, and no CI drift check catches it because the repo copy is self-consistent.
first_seen: 2026-09-19 — `b5614cc7` (#781) added `comparisonFamily` as a required zod enum in `scraper/src/config/field-manifest-schema.ts` AND to `scraper/config/field-manifest.json`. Staging deployed `b12c9d28` at 07:58 IST; the shared manifest was still the 2026-09-18 03:41Z copy from `9c20b4d0`, which lacked the key. Every one of the 190 fields failed validation; the scraper crashed at start in 4-6s and every 30-min cycle failed (02:33:51Z, 02:45:01Z) until the shared file was deployed at 08:26 IST. Prod unaffected (older code, no shared-config symlink)
fix_prs: immediate recovery: `scripts/ops/deploy-config.sh --slot staging --sha b12c9d28` (verified: CONFIG_SHA updated, 190/190 fields carrying comparisonFamily). Open: #793 for the three mechanisms — (1) validate the DEPLOYED config against the DEPLOYED schema as a deploy gate and fail the deploy if the loader refuses, (2) a same-day consumer for `wake-failed ... exit=1` in the wake log, (3) alert on `shared/config/<slot>/CONFIG_SHA` drifting from the served sha, mirroring the existing deploy-drift-monitor
detection_check: none. `check-field-manifest-current.mjs` (pr-gate) compares the REPO manifest against the spec generator and passed, because the repo copy was correct — it has no visibility of what is deployed. Nothing compares deployed config to deployed schema, and nothing reads the wake log: 18 `wake-failed` lines sat in `/var/log/ipodhan-scraper-wake-staging.log` unread
